title: Sales Executive
descriptionHtml:
Join Our Team as a Sales Executive – International Sales

Are you a competitive and results-driven Sales Executive with a passion for international sales? We're seeking a dynamic professional to help us expand our business reach and drive sales growth.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct market research to identify potential sales opportunities and assess customer needs
  • Proactively pursue new sales leads through cold calling, networking, and in-person visits
  • Set up meetings with potential clients and listen to their wishes and concerns
  • Develop and deliver compelling product and service presentations
  • Create frequent reviews and reports with sales and financial data
  • Represent the company at exhibitions, conferences, and other industry events
  • Negotiate and close deals while effectively managing objections and complaints
  • Collaborate with team members to achieve better results
  • Collect customer feedback and share insights with internal teams to drive continuous improvement

What We're Looking For:

  • Proven experience as a Sales Executive or relevant role
  • Fluent in English with strong communication skills
  • Excellent knowledge of MS Office
  • Solid understanding of sales, marketing, and negotiation techniques
  • Fast learner and passion for sales
  • Self-motivated, ambitious, and target-driven
  • Skilled at delivering impactful presentations and building relationships
  • Strong problem-solving abilities
  • BSc/BA in Business, Marketing or a related field.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive remuneration package
  • Exciting opportunities for career growth and professional development
  • A modern, dynamic, and professional work environment

If you're ready to thrive in a supportive, growth-oriented setting, we'd love to hear from you. Submit your CV today to our HR Department at rena@demophorius.com
